# Exploratory Data Analysis



```{r}
Diap <- Diap_raw %>%
  filter(quality_grade == "research",
         taxon_species_name != "",
         !is.na(latitude),
         !is.na(longitude)) %>%
  mutate(taxon_species_name = as.factor(taxon_species_name),
         observed_on = as.Date(observed_on),
         month = month(observed_on),
         cos_month = cos(2 * pi * month / 12),
         sin_month = sin(2 * pi * month / 12)) %>%
  group_by(taxon_species_name) %>%
  filter(n() >= 10) %>%
  ungroup()

Diap_freq <- Diap %>%
  group_by(taxon_species_name) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n()
  )

kable(Diap_freq)
```


```{r}

species_palette <- colorFactor(palette = "Set1", domain = Diap$taxon_species_name)

leaflet(Diap) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery) %>% 
  #addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude, 
    lat = ~latitude,
    color = ~species_palette(taxon_species_name),
    radius = 4,
    fillOpacity = 0.95,
    stroke = FALSE,
    popup = ~paste("<b>Species:</b>", taxon_species_name)
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    pal = species_palette, 
    values = ~taxon_species_name, 
    title = "Species",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```
